columns.name: ID

columns.name: RELEVANCE
columns.description: This is the relevance value for this post.

columns.name: NUM_OCCURRENCES
columns.description: This is the number of occurrences for this result.

columns.name: POST_DATE
columns.description: The date on which the post was created.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
